sentences.text: 2.  Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

3. According to the FIR, the marriage between the applicant and the informant was settled,
engagement done, but subsequently, dowry was demanded and the applicant and his family members declined to marry.
The FIR records that, in fact, during this period the applicant had established physical relations with the informant.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant never met the informant; it is a false FIR; there were some information, which the father of the informant had concealed from the applicant and his family members, therefore, the marriage could not take place.
5. Let State file objections within four weeks.

sentences.text:
7. Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witness in the case.
(ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) He shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) He shall deposit his passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, if the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.
(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.
